text: Should the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute be emitted unconditionally with no opt-out, or should there be a setting to turn it off?
why_it_matters: The requirement allows both. If an opt-out is expected, the change is incomplete; if not, it is fine as is.

text: Should the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute be emitted on all target frameworks where it exists, or only on the non-netstandard2.0/non-.NET Framework set currently guarded?
options: Emit unconditionally (type exists on netstandard2.0 and net4.0+)
why_it_matters: If the attribute is expected on all TFMs the guard is a defect; if the guard is intentional for old TFMs, it is acceptable.
